text:
Yes, there are two kinds of back-seat screen for a Model Y. The right one depends on your model year.

## 1. Aftermarket rear touchscreen (a real display)
These 8.66" Android screens mount on the back of the center console. Most also control rear AC and seat heating, and many support wireless CarPlay. They're mostly listed for **2019-2024 Model Y**, and I didn't see one confirmed for the 2025+ "Juniper" refresh.

- **Tesery 8.66" Android Rear Display**: $359 (regular $409), for Model Y 2020 to March 2025. [Buy at Tesery](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla). Its 4.7 rating comes from only 22 reviews, and the written ones are mixed. Complaints include lag, a screen that keeps entering child-lock mode, and apps that won't finish updating. [Source](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla)
- **Amazon options**: Prices run about $210-$330 ([search results](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-rear-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+rear+screen)).
  - The 8.66" Android 13 unit with 4GB+64GB at $329.99 has the most reviews (41), averaging 3.9 stars.
  - Another 8.66" unit at $279.99 is rated 4.5 but has only 2 reviews.
  - The Tlyard at $210.99 is rated 5.0 but has just 1 review, so I wouldn't trust that rating.

Overall, ratings for these screens are middling (about 3.2-3.9 stars for most). Expect some sluggishness, and check the return policy before you buy. The Aear 8.8" at Squarewheels is currently [sold out](https://squarewheelsauto.com/products/rear-entertainment-screen-for-tesla-model-y).

## 2. Projector screen and sunshade (no wiring)
- **Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema Screen**: $119.99 on [Aurzen's official page](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y). It's a clip-in fabric screen for the rear window or panoramic roof, designed for the **2025-2026 Model Y**. On 2020-2024 cars it only works in roof mode, and the rear panel doesn't fully cover the window.
- It's passive, so you need a **separate portable projector**, which isn't included. It's for use while parked only.
- A 10% code, **CJ10**, was tested at checkout on 2026-10-24 and took $11.99 off, bringing the price to about $108. It can't be combined with Aurzen's automatic sale prices. The page with the code is [here](https://dealectric.com/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-tesla-model-y). That link is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission if you buy through it, at no cost to you. Checkout has the final word on price.

## What I'd buy
- **2020-2024 Model Y, and kids watching while you drive**: a rear touchscreen. Start with the Tesery ($359), which is at least sold direct with a 30-day return window, or a well-reviewed Amazon listing. Confirm your exact model year before ordering.
- **2025-2026 Model Y**: I couldn't confirm a compatible rear display, so the Aurzen screen plus a portable projector is the safer option for parked movie time.

What year is your Model Y, and is this mainly for kids on the road or for parked movie nights? That would let me narrow it to one pick.
